title: Adelic framed form class groups and explicit class field theory
summary: Let $D$ be a negative discriminant, and let $K=\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{D})$. Let $\mathcal{Q}(D)$ denote the set of primitive positive definite binary quadratic forms over $\mathbb{Z}$ of discriminant $D$. We introduce the set of adelic framed forms \begin{equation*} \widehat{\mathcal{Q}}(D)= \left\{(Q,\,γ)\in \mathcal{Q}(D)\times\mathrm{SL}_2(\widehat{\mathbb{Z}})~|~ Q\left(γ\begin{bmatrix}1\\0\end{bmatrix}\right)\in \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}^\times\right\} \end{equation*} and its orbit space $\widehat{C}(D)$ under the natural action of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$.
